value.rationale: The two equal-duration observing-window design is a natural nontrivial geometric constraint for reconstructing an unknown first harmonic plus constant. It has a complete global E-optimal placement classification for every window width, exact worst-case noise amplification, a strict nonperturbative positioning penalty and sharp local curvature. These geometric and stability conclusions are not routine consequences of the known generic eigenvalue decomposition without a global inequality. Broader/higher-band implications are not claimed.
